newsitem.title: USA: NRC may vote on Millstone 3 restart in Dec.
newsitem.headline: NRC may vote on Millstone 3 restart in Dec.

text.p: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Wednesday it could consider the restart of Northeast Utilities Millstone Unit 3 in December, and the restart of its Unit 2 in March.

At an NRC meeting, Northeast officials said Unit 3 should be ready for a safety inspection September 30 and the NRC could vote on its restart at its December 19 meeting. Unit 2 should be ready for inspection December 1, they said.
All three Millstone nuclear units have been closed for safety reasons since March 1996.
"The licensee has focused its recovery/restart efforts on Units 3 and 2 and has delayed activities at Unit 1," an NRC staff paper said.
The NRC document said the Unit 3 inspection should be around Oct 13, and the inspection for Unit 2 should be around Jan 5.
Northeast in its quarterly presentation to the commission, said Unit 1 could be ready for inspection in March, with an NRC restart vote in June.

Northeast CEO Bruce Kenyon said the effort to make the nuclear units qualify for restart was "still a work in progress," annd cited continued concerns about safety conciousness, training and other issues.
But he said, "I'm generally pleased with the progress we're making towards restoration."
